fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide -run '^(TestCheckPlanText|TestCheckPlanNamesNoRepoCommand|TestCheckCodeText|TestCheckCodeNamesNoRepoCommand|TestReviewIsAnIndex|TestBuildReviewCommandBudget)$' shows check-plan holding the compliance and model rules, check-code holding the quality rules, both with the role sections and shared blocks and under the size cap, and the review topic naming check-plan, check-code and check-qa for a conductor run and the old four for the classic workflows; go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestGuideInstallRoleSkills shows skills/rhiza-check-plan/SKILL.md and skills/rhiza-check-code/SKILL.md installed beside the old role skills. Touches internal/guide/text/check-plan.md, internal/guide/text/check-code.md, internal/guide/text/review.md, internal/guide/guide.go, internal/guide/check_plan_test.go, internal/guide/check_code_test.go, internal/guide/review_test.go, internal/guide/budget_test.go, internal/api/guide_install.go, internal/api/guide_install_test.go.
fields.statement: Rhiza ships two review role topics and skills: check-plan (the compliance and model checks' rules merged: each leaf's acceptance met as written, under-built, scope creep, unaccounted files, and code that contradicts the slice) and check-code (the quality check's rules under the new name); check-compliance, check-model and check-quality stay unchanged for the classic ship-change, review and docs-review, and the review index topic names which runs load which topics.
